body_markdown:
NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--[The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2F&esheet=54642942&newsitemid=20261117738750&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Est%26eacute%3Be+Lauder+Companies+Inc.&index=1&md5=a27c88e1f604f3b5257e577d1e428590) (NYSE: EL) (“the Company”) held its Annual Meeting of Stockholders today. William P. Lauder, Chair of the Board of Directors, chaired the meeting.


At the meeting, stockholders elected Stéphane de La Faverie, Jean-Frédéric Dufour, Gary M. Lauder, Jane Lauder and Matthew E. Rubel to the Board as Class III Directors. Stockholders also ratified the appointment of PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP as independent auditors for the current fiscal year and approved the advisory vote to approve executive compensation. The stockholder proposal requesting additional reporting on plastic packaging was not approved.


[The Estée Lauder Companies Inc.](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.elcompanies.com%2Fen&esheet=54642942&newsitemid=20261117738750&lan=en-US&anchor=The+Est%26eacute%3Be+Lauder+Companies+Inc.&index=2&md5=13f5e606a42a72693936a78661cfef34) is one of the world’s leading manufacturers, marketers and sellers of quality skin care, makeup, fragrance and hair care products, and is a steward of luxury and prestige brands globally. The Company’s products are sold in approximately 150 countries and territories under brand names including: Estée Lauder, Aramis, Clinique, Lab Series, Origins, M·A·C, La Mer, Bobbi Brown Cosmetics, Aveda, Jo Malone London, Bumble and bumble, Darphin Paris, TOM FORD, Smashbox, AERIN Beauty, Le Labo, Editions de Parfums Frédéric Malle, GLAMGLOW, KILIAN PARIS, Too Faced, Dr.Jart+, the DECIEM family of brands—including The Ordinary, NIOD, Avestan and Loopha—as well as Balmain Beauty and Forest Essentials.
